description: This file contains the implementation of the Bootstrap ScrollSpy component version 3.3.7, including class definition, methods, plugin setup, and data API initialization.

classes.name: ScrollSpy
classes.description: Class implementing the scrollspy behavior, tracking scroll position and updating active navigation links.

methods.name: getScrollHeight
methods.description: Returns the total scrollable height of the scroll element.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Recalculates offsets and targets based on current DOM state.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles scroll events to activate the appropriate navigation link based on scroll position.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates a target element, updating the active class on navigation links.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes active classes from navigation links.
